snippet.title: Impious: Gameplay Trailer | Dark Turn-Based RPG Demo Release
snippet.description:
Play the Impious demo now: a dark Turn-Based RPG set inside an underground indoctrination center.
✦ PLAY IT FREE ON STEAM ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119710/Impious/
✦ JOIN DISCORD ► https://discord.gg/bcYhNVZhsg

Your only way is forward: fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out. Lose a fight and you won't die, but you will be corrected. Lose your will entirely, and there is no coming back.

Captured for your sins and dragged into the depths, you wake inside a system designed to break you. Every door hides a different threat. Every choice leaves a mark. Obey their rules or learn to break them.

#turnbasedRPG #indiegame #darkRPG #pcgaming #steamdemo #indiedev #gamedev
